title: Shielded pool balances
description: Daily balances from chain state, split by pool. These are stocks of ZEC, not daily inflows.

title: Issued supply
description: Shielded and transparent balances. Future issuance and unmined supply are excluded.

title: Shielded share of supply
description: Shielded balance divided by issued chain supply. The 21M maximum is not the denominator.

title: After deshielding
description: Tracked value by deshielding date and its latest observed destination. Cohort outcomes can change as funds move.

title: Leading mining pool share
description: Largest attributed share of each day’s blocks. The leading pool may change; partial days can be volatile.

title: Search interest in “zcash”
description: Worldwide Google Trends index, normalized within its export window. Incomplete weeks are excluded. Search attention is unscored.
window: Imported weekly CSV · not automatically updated

title: Daily transaction activity
description: Shielded and transparent transactions per day. Coinbase is excluded from the transparent count.

title: Shielded transaction share
description: Daily shielded share of shielded plus non-coinbase transparent transactions.

title: Privacy Score history
description: Recorded model scores out of 100. Formula changes can cause steps; this is not a probability of privacy.

title: Public shielding flows
description: Daily public value entering and leaving shielded pools. Private transfers inside pools are not visible.

title: Net public shielding
description: Shielding minus deshielding per day. This is not the total change in shielded balances.

title: Flows above an amount
description: Counts at or above each ZEC threshold. Thresholds overlap; they do not measure an anonymity set.

title: Flows by amount range
description: Public flow counts in non-overlapping ZEC ranges. Each flow belongs to one bucket.

title: Estimated network hashrate
description: Daily mining power estimated from difficulty and block production.

title: Blocks by mining pool
description: Observed block production by attributed pool. Unidentified miners retain their source labels.

title: Coinbase reward spending
description: Reward cohorts earned, subsequently moved and still held. A movement does not establish a sale.

title: Recent block intervals
description: Differences between adjacent block timestamps. Missing predecessors leave gaps; negative intervals are preserved.

title: Mining difficulty
description: Difficulty averaged over 100 blocks. Sample positions use actual block heights.

title: Fees per block
description: Average fees per block each completed UTC day, excluding subsidy. Mainnet blocks became three times as frequent at NU7 on November 6, 2026.

title: Transactions per block
description: Average transactions per block each completed UTC day, including coinbase. Mainnet blocks became three times as frequent at NU7 on November 6, 2026.

title: Observed transaction fees
description: Daily median and 10th/90th percentiles of observed fees. This is not a fee quote.

title: Explorer node storage
description: Disk usage reported by this explorer’s node. It is not a measurement of every node or only block files.

title: Shielded note commitments
description: Cumulative Sapling outputs and Orchard/Ironwood actions. Includes padding; these are not unique people or wallets.

title: Shielded nullifiers
description: Sapling spends and Orchard/Ironwood action counts. Actions can include dummy spends; these are not counts of real transfers.

title: Price and modeled realized price
description: Daily historical USD price and modeled cost basis. These are daily observations, not a live quote.

title: MVRV
description: Market capitalization divided by modeled realized capitalization. 1× is not a fair-value threshold.

title: Modeled unrealized profit / loss
description: NUPL = 1 − 1/MVRV. Another view of the same model, not an independent confirming signal.

title: SOPR · transparent spends
description: Spent-output value relative to its creation value. Only the transparent-spend series is shown; missing data stays unavailable.

title: Market and modeled realized cap
description: Daily reported market capitalization alongside the modeled realized capitalization estimate.

title: Age of spent ZEC
description: Mean age per positive-value transparent output spent per day. Shielded note ages are not observable.

title: Coin-days destroyed
description: Transparent value moved × output age, summed per day. Spikes do not prove selling.

title: Unspent ZEC by output age
description: Transparent ZEC by time since output creation. Output age is not the age of an owner’s position.

title: Cross-chain swap volume
description: Observed ZEC-related swaps through indexed providers, valued in USD. This is not all exchange activity.

title: Cross-chain swap activity
description: Observed swaps into and out of ZEC through indexed providers. Coverage is limited to those providers.
